mapper.sql: id,tenant_id AS tenantId,name,filter_json AS filterJson,deleted,created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt,updated_at AS updatedAt,version
FROM crm_customer_segment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0 AND name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM crm_customer_segment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND deleted=0
SELECT FROM crm_customer_segment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND name=#{name} AND deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_customer_segment SET name=#{name},filter_json=#{filterJson},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND deleted=0
UPDATE crm_customer_segment SET deleted=1,version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND deleted=0

sql.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_customer_attention_project ap WHERE ap.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND ap.customer_id=c.id AND ap.project_id IN #{projectId})

AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_entitlement pe INNER JOIN crm_entitlement_ledger pl ON pl.tenant_id=pe.tenant_id AND pl.entitlement_id=pe.id WHERE pe.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND pe.customer_id=c.id AND pe.project_id IN #{projectId} AND pl.txn_type='GRANT' AND pl.delta_count > 0)

AND EXISTS (SELECT re.project_id FROM crm_entitlement re INNER JOIN crm_entitlement_ledger rl ON rl.tenant_id=re.tenant_id AND rl.entitlement_id=re.id WHERE re.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND re.customer_id=c.id AND re.project_id IN #{projectId} AND rl.txn_type IN ('REDEEM','CORRECTION_IN') GROUP BY re.project_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN rl.txn_type='REDEEM' THEN -rl.delta_count WHEN rl.txn_type='CORRECTION_IN' AND rl.source_type='REDEMPTION_REVERSAL' THEN -rl.delta_count ELSE 0 END) >= #{filters.redeemedMinCount})

mapper.sql: FROM crm_customer c LEFT JOIN sys_user o ON o.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND o.id=c.owner_staff_id WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY c.id ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

when.test: scopeType == 'TEAM' and teamIds != null and teamIds.size() > 0

choose.otherwise: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_customer c WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.deleted=0
